set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Pinned fonts and renderer settings produce controlled goldens.
- Perceptual thresholds and artifact review workflow are documented.
- Fuzzers cover malformed scenes, mappings, transforms, breaks, and layout without hangs or leaked exceptions.
set.title: [Intaglio 1.0][Assurance] Automate golden, perceptual, and fuzz regression
